subject: Latency clarifications + next steps for BrightCart POC
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@brightcart.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial latency numbers from our test run

Hi Soojin — thanks for the call earlier. As promised, attaching the raw run and a short summary of what we observed on our side. Quick highlights: 

- Test setup: 2x A100 equivalent (multi-tenant), model variant: redwood-3b-8bit, sequence length 512, batch sizes tested at 1, 4, 8.
- Steady-state single-request: p50 ~ 42 ms, p90 ~ 110 ms, p99 ~ 230 ms (measured over 10k tokens). We saw a p99 tail when concurrent batches exceeded 6.
- Throughput: ~720 tokens/sec for sustained batching (batch=4, seq=512). Tokenization overhead added ~10–12 ms per request.
- KV cache behavior: warm KV cache dropped ~15% of per-token latency; cold-warm transition lasted ~3–4 requests for common prefixes.

Notes / caveats: our infra is shared with some batch jobs; the p99 spike corresponds to ephemeral GC activity in the toolchain. We captured logs around the spike in the attached PDF (brightcart_latency_run_0206.pdf).

Let me know if you want the raw CSV and we can e-mail that separately. Happy to jump back on a quick call to walk through the attachment.

--
Oliver Grant
Head of Platform Engineering
BrightCart

Oliver — thanks for the detailed run and the PDF. Short recap from our side + proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

1) What we heard from you:
   - p50 ~42 ms, p90 ~110 ms, p99 ~230 ms; spikes correlated with GC and concurrent batch pressure.
   - Sustained throughput ~720 tok/s at batch=4; tokenization ~10–12 ms overhead.

2) Redwood follow-ups we committed to on the call:
   - Share a recommended config for lower p99 (suggested kernel path and batch window).
   - Run a controlled bench with a dedicated instance to remove shared-workload noise and provide per-sequence breakdown.
   - Provide a short doc describing our KV cache warmup behavior.

3) Proposed next steps and timing:
   - Redwood does a dedicated bench (we’ll provision a dedicated slot) and shares results by EOD Feb 16.
   - If the dedicated bench shows expected p99 reduction, propose a 2-week POC (trial capacity) starting Feb 23.
   - BrightCart to confirm priority and decision maker for the POC by Feb 18.

Can you confirm the decision-maker and whether Feb 23 start still looks doable on your side? I’ll attach the config we plan to run and the KV cache note separately.

Thanks — Soojin
